crm-revenue.title: Revenue report
crm-revenue.subtitle: What you invoiced, how much of it is paid and what is still owed, and the money that came in, for the period you choose.
crm-revenue.stale: The figures could not be refreshed. These are the last ones loaded.

empty.title: Nothing in this period
empty.message: No invoice was issued and no payment came in between these dates. Pick another period, or open the invoices.

note.converted: Several currencies are in use. The figures are converted into {currency}; choose one currency to see its exact amounts.
note.missingRate: No exchange rate for {currencies}: those amounts are left out of the converted figures.
note.invoiced: Invoiced, paid and owed count the invoices issued in the period (drafts, voided invoices and proformas are left out). Collected and refunded count the money that came in during the period, whichever invoice it settled.

kpi.title: Key figures
kpi.outstandingHint: {count, plural, one {# open invoice} other {# open invoices}} as of today
kpi.taxHint: On invoices fully paid in the period
kpi.invoicedHint: {count, plural, one {# invoice issued} other {# invoices issued}}
kpi.paidHint: Of the invoices issued in the period

flow.title: Invoiced, paid and owed
flow.subtitle: The invoices issued in the period, and where they stand today
flow.empty: Nothing was invoiced in this period.
flow.several: These invoices are in several currencies. Choose a currency above to see them as one bar.

trend.title: Invoiced and collected
trend.chartLabel: Invoiced and collected over the period

split.title: By {group}
split.subtitle: The biggest first. Money is shown in {currency}.
split.subtitlePerCurrency: The biggest first. Money is listed per currency.
split.truncated: Only the {count} biggest rows are listed. The CSV summary has the same rows.
split.teamNote: Each person counts for their primary team only, so team rows add up to the total. People with no primary team are listed under no team.
split.productNote: Discounts on the whole invoice, shipping and rounding are spread over the lines in proportion to their value.

export.title: Download this report
export.note: Prepared in the background with the filters above, kept for {days} days and announced by email. You get no more than the report shows you.
export.csvPaymentsHint: One line per payment and refund of the period
export.csvSummaryHint: The split above, with the totals
export.requested: Your file is being prepared. You will get an email when it is ready, and it will appear in the list below.
export.none: You have not prepared a file yet.
export.failed: This file could not be prepared. Ask for it again.

errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.exportInProgress: A file is already being prepared for you. Wait for its email, then ask for another.
errors.exportNotReady: This file is not ready or has expired. Ask for it again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
